notes.title: VR Museum is going live!
notes.content:
Extra! Extra! The VR Museum is coming to Steam!

The wait is almost over, dear readers, as the VR Museum is finally making its way to Steam. This innovative platform takes you on a journey through the annals of history, bringing you closer to the wonders of the world in a way you never thought possible.

Stay tuned for more updates as we await approval from the Steam crew. We can't wait to share this amazing experience with you!
